## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete failure and the smallest change that fixes it.

## Validation

Exact commands and results, including the failing regression before the fix.
State skipped checks, inherited CI failures and untested platforms explicitly.

## Sources and limits

Behavioral reference, related issue/PR, unchanged gameplay contracts and any
save/replay compatibility effect. Do not include proprietary data or raw captures.

## AI assistance

If used: tool and verified model for generation/review; unknown if not recorded.
Model names do not replace the validation evidence above.
